title: PM Modi Visits Indonesia: BrahMos Missile Deal Signed, Prambanan Temple Visit Highlights Cultural Ties
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded his visit to Indonesia with the signing of key agreements, including Indonesia's purchase of BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles. Modi visited the Prambanan Temple complex, emphasising shared cultural heritage between India and Indonesia. The visit marks a significant deepening of defence and cultural ties between the two nations.
exam_angle: BrahMos exports strengthen India's defence diplomacy and 'Make in India' in defence; India-Indonesia relations are important for Indo-Pacific strategy and ASEAN engagement.
key_facts: Indonesia to purchase BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles from India
PM Modi visited Prambanan Temple — a UNESCO World Heritage Hindu temple complex in Java
BrahMos is a joint venture between India's DRDO and Russia's NPO Mashinostroyenia
Visit part of broader India-ASEAN and Indo-Pacific outreach

title: PM Modi's Australia Visit: Uranium Deal and Defence Ties on Agenda
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Australia, with uranium supply and defence cooperation featuring prominently on the agenda. The visit is expected to further cement the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between India and Australia. Discussions are also expected to cover trade, technology, and collaboration under the Quad framework.
exam_angle: India-Australia relations are key for UPSC IR; uranium deal is significant for India's civil nuclear energy programme; Australia is a member of Quad alongside India, US, and Japan.
key_facts: India and Australia share a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (since 2020)
Australia is one of the world's largest uranium exporters
Both are members of the Quad grouping
India requires uranium imports to fuel its nuclear power plants under civilian nuclear agreements

title: US Indicts Lawrence Bishnoi Gang Over Hardeep Singh Nijjar's Murder in Canada
summary: US prosecutors have charged Indian gangster Lawrence Bishnoi and associates, including Goldy Brar and Rohit Godara (linked to Bhagwanpuria gang), with organising the murder of Sikh activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada. A Punjab Police SHO was also among 37 individuals named by the US. Canada's police separately stated that their 'Operation Hard Ball' investigation found no evidence directly linking the Indian government to Nijjar's killing.
exam_angle: Relevant to India-Canada diplomatic tensions, extraterritorial jurisdiction, India-US law enforcement cooperation, and the ongoing Khalistan issue in India's foreign policy.
key_facts: Hardeep Singh Nijjar was a Khalistani activist killed in Surrey, Canada in June 2023
US indicted Lawrence Bishnoi gang; 37 individuals named including a Punjab Police SHO
Canada's 'Operation Hard Ball' found no direct evidence linking Indian government to the killing
Lawrence Bishnoi is currently lodged in Indian jail; his gang is linked to multiple high-profile crimes in India

title: CSIR-NAL Completes Design of Indigenous 19-Seater Saras MkII Light Transport Aircraft
summary: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research – National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL) has completed the design of the Saras MkII, an indigenous 19-seater light transport aircraft. The development is a significant milestone for India's civilian aircraft manufacturing capability. The minister described it as a major step towards Atmanirbhar Bharat in aviation.
exam_angle: Relevant to India's self-reliance in aerospace/defence manufacturing, CSIR-NAL's role in indigenous aviation technology, and GS Paper 3 science-tech topics.
key_facts: Developed by: CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL), Bengaluru
Aircraft: Saras MkII — 19-seater light transport aircraft
Saras is India's first indigenously designed and developed civil aircraft
Significance: Part of Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative in aerospace sector

title: India Monitoring Strait of Hormuz Amid Escalating US-Iran Conflict
summary: India is closely monitoring the Strait of Hormuz following recent ship attacks and fresh US military strikes on Iran after President Trump declared the Iran ceasefire 'over'. The Strait of Hormuz is critical for India's energy security, as a large portion of India's oil imports pass through it. The escalation has also caused Indian stock markets to crash, with Sensex falling over 1,700 points.
exam_angle: Strait of Hormuz is critical for India's energy security; US-Iran escalation impacts global oil prices, India's current account deficit, and maritime security (relevant for GS Paper 2 IR and GS Paper 3 Economy).
key_facts: Strait of Hormuz: narrow waterway between Iran and Oman; ~20% of global oil trade passes through it
India imports ~85% of its crude oil needs; significant share transits via Hormuz
Trump declared Iran ceasefire 'over'; US launched fresh strikes on Iran
Sensex fell over 1,700 points; oil prices jumped ~5% on escalation fears

title: IMF Lowers 2026 Global Growth Forecast to 3%; India's GDP Forecast Marginally Reduced
summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has revised its 2026 global growth forecast downward to 3%, citing the impact of the US-Iran war escalation on energy prices and global trade. India's GDP growth forecast was also marginally reduced, though India was still identified as among the fastest-growing major economies. The IMF sees a rebound in 2027.
exam_angle: IMF growth forecasts are standard exam facts; global growth slowdown impacts India's exports and current account; relevant to GS Paper 3 (Economy) and GS Paper 2 (IR — multilateral institutions).
key_facts: IMF 2026 global growth forecast: 3% (revised downward)
Reason for downward revision: US-Iran conflict, rising oil prices, trade disruptions
India remains among the fastest-growing major economies despite marginal cut
IMF projects a rebound in global growth in 2027

title: India's Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in Higher Education Hits 30%, But Lags 2035 Target
summary: India's Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education has reached 30%, a milestone in expanding access to tertiary education. However, the current pace of growth is insufficient to achieve the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 target of 50% GER by 2035. The data highlights the need for accelerated investment in higher education infrastructure.
exam_angle: GER is a key indicator for education policy; NEP 2020 set a target of 50% GER by 2035; relevant to GS Paper 2 (Social Issues — Education).
key_facts: Current GER in higher education: 30%
NEP 2020 target: 50% GER in higher education by 2035
GER = ratio of total enrolment in a specific level of education to the population of the age group corresponding to that level
India has the world's largest higher education system by number of institutions

title: Allahabad High Court: Child Marriage Prohibition Act Applies to All Religions
summary: The Allahabad High Court has ruled that the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act (PCMA) applies to all religions in India, including Muslims. The court held that no personal law can override the secular statutory law protecting children from early marriage. This ruling has significant implications for the debate on a Uniform Civil Code and child rights.
exam_angle: Critical for GS Paper 2 Polity — intersection of personal laws, secular legislation, and child rights; also relevant to UCC debate and Supreme Court's earlier judgments on PCMA.
key_facts: Court: Allahabad High Court
Law in question: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act (PCMA), 2006
Ruling: PCMA applies to all religions; personal law cannot override it
Minimum age of marriage in India: 18 for women, 21 for men (proposed increase to 21 for women pending)

title: RBI and Government Back Crypto Ban; Tax Department Warns of Evasion Risks
summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reiterated its support for a complete ban on private cryptocurrencies in India, according to internal documents. The Income Tax Department has separately warned of significant tax evasion risks associated with crypto transactions. India currently taxes Virtual Digital Assets (VDAs) at 30% but has not enacted a comprehensive crypto regulation law.
exam_angle: RBI's stance on crypto is frequently asked; India's crypto taxation framework (30% tax, 1% TDS) and the pending Cryptocurrency and Regulation of Official Digital Currency Bill are key exam topics.
key_facts: RBI position: Supports ban on private cryptocurrencies
India taxes Virtual Digital Assets (VDAs) at 30% flat rate + 1% TDS (since Budget 2022-23)
RBI has been developing its own Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) — 'Digital Rupee' (e₹)
A comprehensive crypto regulation bill is yet to be passed by Parliament

title: India-Maldives Begin Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Negotiations
summary: India and the Maldives have formally commenced negotiations for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) aimed at boosting bilateral economic ties. The development comes amid the backdrop of recent strains in India-Maldives relations following the election of President Mohamed Muizzu and his 'India Out' campaign. An FTA would significantly enhance trade and investment flows between the two neighbours.
exam_angle: India-Maldives relations are important for 'Neighbourhood First' policy and India's Indian Ocean strategy; FTA negotiations signal renewed economic engagement; relevant for GS Paper 2 (IR).
key_facts: India is Maldives' largest trading partner and a key source of tourists
FTA negotiations signal effort to reset India-Maldives ties after 'India Out' episode
Maldives is strategically located in the Indian Ocean, critical for India's maritime security
India has existing FTAs with ASEAN, Sri Lanka, and is negotiating with the UK, EU, etc.

title: India-Myanmar 23rd National Level Meeting Concludes in New Delhi
summary: The 23rd National Level Meeting between India and Myanmar was held in New Delhi, covering bilateral cooperation on border management, connectivity, and development projects. The meeting is part of regular institutional dialogue between the two countries. India shares a 1,643 km border with Myanmar across four northeastern states.
exam_angle: India-Myanmar relations are relevant for Act East Policy, border security, connectivity projects (Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project, India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway), and Northeast India development.
key_facts: India shares a 1,643 km border with Myanmar (across Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram)
Key connectivity project: Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project
India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway is a major connectivity initiative
Meeting covered border management, connectivity, and bilateral development cooperation

title: E20 Fuel Controversy: Backlash Against Ethanol-Blended Petrol Intensifies in India
summary: India's rollout of E20 fuel (petrol blended with 20% ethanol) has faced significant public and industry backlash, with concerns over reduced mileage, engine compatibility, and consumer deception. Former Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal wrote to 29 automakers seeking clarification on their vehicles' compatibility with E20. The government's National Biofuel Policy aims for 20% ethanol blending in petrol by 2025-26.
exam_angle: India's Ethanol Blending Programme (EBP) is a key GS Paper 3 topic covering energy policy, biofuels, and environmental sustainability; the E20 controversy raises consumer protection and regulatory issues.
key_facts: E20: Petrol blended with 20% ethanol
India's target: 20% ethanol blending in petrol by 2025-26 (advanced from 2030 under National Biofuel Policy 2018)
Ethanol blending reduces dependence on crude oil imports and lowers carbon emissions
India achieved ~15% blending in 2023-24; E20 rollout began in select cities
source: BBC / Reuters / The Times of India

title: SBI Funds Management IPO to Open on July 14; India's Largest Asset Manager Targets $1.2 Billion
summary: SBI Funds Management Limited (SBIFML), the asset management arm of State Bank of India and one of India's largest mutual fund managers, has filed its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP) for an IPO opening on July 14. The issue is expected to raise approximately $1.2 billion (around Rs 10,000 crore), attracting interest from major sovereign wealth funds. This is one of the most significant financial sector IPOs in recent years.
exam_angle: SBI Mutual Fund is the largest AMC in India by AUM; IPO of financial sector entities is relevant to GS Paper 3 (Economy — capital markets, banking sector); SEBI's role in regulating IPOs.
key_facts: SBI Funds Management Ltd (SBIFML) is the asset management company of SBI Mutual Fund
IPO opens: July 14; target size: ~$1.2 billion (~Rs 10,000 crore)
SBI MF is India's largest mutual fund by Assets Under Management (AUM)
Regulated by SEBI under SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996

title: ULPIN and DIGIPIN Integration: Department of Land Resources Meets NIUA and Department of Posts
summary: The Department of Land Resources held a brainstorming meeting with the National Institute of Urban Affairs (NIUA) and the Department of Posts to explore the integration of ULPIN (Unique Land Parcel Identification Number) with DIGIPIN (Digital Postal Index Number). The integration aims to create a unified geospatial addressing system linking land records with postal addresses. This is a key step towards modernising India's land governance and digital public infrastructure.
exam_angle: ULPIN ('Bhu-Aadhar') and DIGIPIN are important digital governance initiatives; their integration is relevant for GS Paper 2 (Governance — e-governance, land reforms) and GS Paper 3 (Economy — land markets).
key_facts: ULPIN: Unique Land Parcel Identification Number — a 14-digit unique ID for every land parcel in India (also called 'Bhu-Aadhar')
DIGIPIN: Digital Postal Index Number — a geo-coded addressing system by India Post (10-character alphanumeric code)
Nodal Ministry for ULPIN: Department of Land Resources (under Ministry of Rural Development)
Integration aims to link land records with postal/geospatial addresses for better governance

title: Sports Authority of India and Safdarjung Sports Injury Centre Sign MoU for Sports Science
summary: Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Safdarjung Sports Injury Centre have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen sports science support and athlete care in India. The collaboration aims to provide elite athletes with improved access to sports medicine, injury rehabilitation, and performance science services. This supports India's push for better Olympic and international sports performance.
exam_angle: SAI is the nodal body for sports development in India under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports; sports science infrastructure is relevant for GS Paper 2 (Governance — sports policy).
key_facts: MoU signed between: Sports Authority of India (SAI) and Safdarjung Sports Injury Centre
SAI operates under: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Objective: Strengthen sports science, injury management, and athlete care
Safdarjung Hospital is a Central Government hospital under Ministry of Health & Family Welfare

title: India Post Partners with Mahanagar Gas for Technology-Enabled Gas Meter Reading in Mumbai
summary: India Post and Mahanagar Gas Limited (MGL) have partnered to deliver technology-enabled gas meter reading services across Mumbai. India Post's vast network of postmen will be used to conduct doorstep meter readings using handheld devices, leveraging the Department of Posts' last-mile connectivity. This is part of India Post's broader initiative to leverage its network for non-postal services.
exam_angle: India Post's diversification into financial and utility services is relevant for GS Paper 2 (Governance); Mahanagar Gas is a city gas distribution company; demonstrates PPP model for utility services.
key_facts: Partners: India Post (Department of Posts) and Mahanagar Gas Limited (MGL)
Service: Technology-enabled gas meter reading in Mumbai
India Post has ~1.55 lakh post offices — the world's largest postal network
MGL is a joint venture of GAIL (India) Ltd and British Gas for city gas distribution in Mumbai

title: Mahadev Betting App Founder Saurabh Chandrakar Arrested in Oman
summary: Saurabh Chandrakar, the co-founder of the illegal Mahadev Online Book betting app, has been arrested in Oman. Chandrakar, along with Ravi Uppal, is accused of running a massive online betting and gambling racket worth thousands of crores. Indian agencies including the Enforcement Directorate (ED) had been pursuing him after he fled India; his extradition is now being sought.
exam_angle: Mahadev App case involves PMLA (Prevention of Money Laundering Act), ED jurisdiction, online gambling regulation, and international law enforcement cooperation — all GS Paper 2/3 topics.
key_facts: Arrested: Saurabh Chandrakar, co-founder of Mahadev Online Book app
Location of arrest: Oman
Investigating agency in India: Enforcement Directorate (ED) under PMLA, 2002
Case involves alleged online betting worth thousands of crores; linked to money laundering

title: PM Modi Visits Exhibition Marking Golden Jubilee (60 Years) of 1965 India-Pakistan War
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited an exhibition organised to commemorate the Golden Jubilee of the 1965 India-Pakistan War (Operation Gibraltar / Battle of Asal Uttar). The 1965 war, fought in September, was a significant conflict where India repulsed Pakistan's offensive. The year 2025-26 marks 60 years of the war.
exam_angle: The 1965 war is important for defence history; key battles include Asal Uttar (Patton Nagar) and Haji Pir Pass; concluded with the Tashkent Agreement (January 1966) mediated by USSR.
key_facts: 1965 India-Pakistan War fought in August–September 1965
Key Indian victories: Battle of Asal Uttar (where Pakistan's Patton tanks were destroyed), Haji Pir Pass
War ended with Tashkent Agreement (January 10, 1966), mediated by Soviet Union
2025-26 marks 60th anniversary (Diamond/Golden Jubilee) of the 1965 war

title: Google Selects 20 Indian AI-First Startups for 2026 India Accelerator Programme
summary: Google has selected 20 Indian artificial intelligence (AI) startups for its 2026 India Accelerator cohort. The programme, part of Google for Startups Accelerator, provides mentorship, technical support, and access to Google's AI tools and cloud infrastructure. The initiative reflects India's growing prominence as an AI startup hub.
exam_angle: India's AI startup ecosystem and government's IndiaAI Mission are GS Paper 3 topics; Google's investment in India's digital economy is relevant to FDI and technology policy.
key_facts: Programme: Google for Startups Accelerator — India (2026 batch)
Selected: 20 AI-first Indian startups
India launched the IndiaAI Mission (2024) with Rs 10,371 crore budget for AI ecosystem development
India ranks among the top 5 globally in AI startup ecosystem
